title: Output Length Effect on DeepSeek-R1’s Safety in Forced Thinking

bias_targets.methodology: The paper includes 'bias' as a specific category within its security-focused dataset of over 100,000 prompts. The model's responses to these prompts, alongside various adversarial attack strategies (e.g., prompt injections, obfuscation), are evaluated using an automated judgment model by HydroX AI, which assigns a safety score between 0 and 1.
